Software Engineer — Python Backend
        Company: TechCorp Solutions
        Location: Bangalore, India | Remote OK

        We are looking for a Python backend developer to build scalable APIs and data pipelines.

        Required Skills: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, REST API, Git, Linux
        Preferred Skills: Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, SQLAlchemy

        Responsibilities:
        - Design and build RESTful APIs using FastAPI or Django
        - Write clean, well-tested Python code
        - Manage PostgreSQL databases and write complex queries
        - Deploy services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines

        Requirements:
        - 2+ years of experience in Python backend development
        - Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
        - Experience with Docker and containerization
        - Familiarity with Linux command line

        Salary: 8-15 LPA

Data Scientist — Machine Learning Engineer
        Company: DataMind Analytics
        Location: Hyderabad, India | Hybrid

        Join our ML team to build predictive models and recommendation systems.

        Required Skills: Python, Machine Learning, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, TensorFlow
        Preferred Skills: PyTorch, Spark, Airflow, AWS SageMaker, Deep Learning, NLP

        Responsibilities:
        - Build and deploy machine learning models for production
        - Work with large datasets using Pandas and NumPy
        - Implement deep learning solutions using TensorFlow or PyTorch
        - Collaborate with data engineers on data pipelines

        Requirements:
        - 3+ years in data science or machine learning
        - Strong Python and statistics knowledge
        - Experience with ML model deployment
        - Knowledge of SQL for data extraction

        Salary: 12-22 LPA

TechNova Solutions Pvt. Ltd. 
Job Title: Senior Python Developer 
Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid) 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Required: 5+ Years 
ABOUT THE COMPANY 
TechNova Solutions is a fast-growing product-based technology company specializing in cloud-native 
enterprise software, AI-powered analytics platforms, and scalable microservices architecture. With 
over 800 employees across 5 global offices, TechNova serves Fortune 500 clients in banking, 
healthcare, and e-commerce verticals. 
ROLE OVERVIEW 
We are seeking an experienced Senior Python Developer to join our Platform Engineering team. The 
ideal candidate will design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services, RESTful APIs, 
and data pipelines. You will work closely with DevOps, Data Science, and Frontend teams to deliver 
robust, scalable solutions. 
RESPONSIBILITIES - Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI or Django REST Framework - Build and optimize data pipelines using Apache Kafka, Celery, and PostgreSQL - Implement microservices architecture and containerize applications using Docker and Kubernetes - Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS) - Write comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and perform code reviews - Collaborate with DevOps to implement CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions - Optimize database queries and design efficient PostgreSQL and MongoDB schemas - Mentor junior developers and conduct technical interviews - Participate in agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives - Document APIs, architecture decisions, and deployment procedures 
REQUIRED SKILLS - Python (5+ years) - FastAPI or Django REST Framework 
- PostgreSQL - advanced querying, indexing, optimization - Docker - containerization - AWS - EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda (2+ years) - Git - version control - SQL - complex queries, window functions - Linux/Unix - command line, shell scripting - Bachelor's degr
